title: ComparisonToSynthesis
description: CRITICAL SHARED CONTRACT. This is the boundary between the retrieval/analysis workstream (Agents 1-4) and the synthesis/verification workstream (Agents 5-7). Agents 5-7 build entirely against this schema in Phase 1, using the mocks/ fixtures. Neither side should silently change this schema without updating this file.

source_claim_id.description: The Analysis-agent claim_id this row was built from. Owned by Comparison agent (Ayush / Agents 1-4). null only for rows synthesized from multiple findings with no single originating claim_id — should be rare.

description.description: null when present = false. Never empty string.

_invariants: Every comparison row must have comparison_id, sub_question_id, claim, and at least one evidence item.

Nullable fields (approach, dataset, architecture, comparison_group, disagreement.description, source_claim_id) are represented as null, never empty string. This distinction matters for downstream validation (see mocks/comparison_malformed.json for what violating this looks like).
source_claim_id must be copied forward from the originating Analysis finding's claim_id by the Comparison agent (Ayush / Agents 1-4 responsibility).
